item.title: Multi-User Dungeon (MUD)
item.description:
📝 From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Video game genre This article is about a type of online computer game. Many MUDs were fashioned around the dice-rolling rules of the Dungeons & Dragons series of games. [10][12] Indeed, before the invention of the term MMORPG, games of this style were simply called graphical MUDs.
